title: The Last Monsoon
author: Emrys Underhill
blurb: Petra Galloway, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
